title: Shortest Subarray with Sum at Least K
summary: Given an integer array and a target sum, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least the target.
statement: Given an integer array and a target sum, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least the target. If no such subarray exists, return -1.
constraints: nums is nonempty and may contain negative values; k is positive.
Return the minimum length of a nonempty contiguous subarray with sum at least k.
hints: Use prefix sums so a subarray sum is a difference of two prefixes.
Keep candidate starting prefixes in increasing value order and increasing index order.
Pop the front while the target is met; pop the back while the new prefix is no larger.
Front pops produce shortest feasible endings, and dominated larger or older prefixes can never improve a future result.
editorial: Front pops produce shortest feasible endings, and dominated larger or older prefixes can never improve a future result.
